text:
**My pick for a slim Qi2 power bank for iPhone 17 is the Anker Nano Power Bank (5K).** If you'd rather have more capacity and faster wireless charging, the INIU SnapGo Air 10K is the better choice.

**Best slim overall: [Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), $54.99**
- It's 0.34 in thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and Qi2 15W wireless charging. [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- 9to5Mac's reviewer has used it extensively and calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. They also say it runs cooler than the competition. [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)
- A 5K bank usually gets a phone to about 60-75%, per Macworld. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**Best slim with more power: INIU SnapGo Air 10K (25W Qi2.2), about $43-49**
- It's 0.5 in thick and 195g, with 10,000mAh and 25W wireless charging. The iPhone 17 supports 25W. Wired charging is 45W, and a 60W lanyard-style cable is built in. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K bank, with a digital display but no kickstand. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
- Android Central shows it at $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 at INIU. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53-70**
- It's 0.27 in thick and 104g. Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the lot. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- Its wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, so it's the slowest of these when it's attached to your phone.

**Which to choose**
- For the thinnest option with solid wireless speed, get the Anker.
- For a full recharge or more, with a bit more thickness, get the INIU.
- Skip the Baseus unless thinness matters more to you than wireless speed.

I only have Amazon prices from the Android Central review, not direct buy pages, so the INIU and Baseus links go to that article, which has the purchase buttons. Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout. Also, most of these sites earn affiliate commissions.
